item.tib: gnas chen gyer ri'i gsol 'debs rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung
item.coloph: ces rnam mkhyen rgyal ba gshen rab kyi gsol 'debs byin rlabs mngon 'jug thugs rje'i nyag thag 'di ni/ 'khrul snang rmi lam ngos bud med dkar mo rma bya'i la'u can dang / khye'u chung dar dkar gyi la thod bcings pa gnyis kyis grogs byas nas/ gyer ri nyid la skor ba song snang ngang nas gnas kyi lo rgyus dang yon tan brjod par gyur ba gzhir bcas/ lhan grub 'od gsal gyi rang mdangs nyams snang la rab rib shar bzhin/ shel skyes tshe dbang bde chen snying pos shar grol smin gling rab gsal nyi 'od khang du bris nas spel ba 'dis 'gro rnams lhun grub 'od gsal gyi snang ba thams cad rang shar rang grol nas phyi gsal gzhi dbyings kaH dag gdod ma'i ngang du thim nas gzhon nu bum pa can gyi skur bzhengs pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
